subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should the remaining TUI work be docs/help for the existing pi-tui newline bindings only, or should OpenClaw expose a public configurable send/newline keybinding bridge?
rationale: The central Shift+Enter behavior exists through pi-tui, but deciding whether to add a new OpenClaw config/keybinding surface is product and compatibility policy rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Document Existing Bindings
options.body: Add TUI docs and `/help` coverage for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and the backslash-enter fallback while keeping Enter-to-send unchanged.

options.title: Expose Configurable Keybindings
options.body: Bridge OpenClaw TUI config or agent keybindings into pi-tui so users can choose send/newline shortcuts, with schema/help/docs and compatibility tests.

options.title: Close As Implemented
options.body: Treat pi-tui's current Shift+Enter support as sufficient and leave configurability to adjacent TUI editor issues.

recommendation.title: Document Existing Bindings
recommendation.body: Add TUI docs and `/help` coverage for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and the backslash-enter fallback while keeping Enter-to-send unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest TUI ownership signal and already framed the prior product scope for this issue.
